lane: AI runtime: Tarot output check tolerates malformed section keys
goal: The first Tarot AI call on Singapore (09/11) was a complete JSON reply rejected with code section_key, so the user got the canned fallback. A section key is an internal identifier never shown to users, and the app already replaces a missing key with section_N. Replace a missing or malformed key with section_N on the server instead of discarding the whole answer; keep rejecting duplicate keys and every other rule.
successCriteria: A reply whose section key is missing, not a string, or not matching the key pattern (for example accented Vietnamese or spaces) passes with key section_N (N = 1-based position).
Duplicate valid keys, unknown card IDs, wrong locale, extra fields and over-long text are still rejected.
The replacement key is built from the position only, never from model prose, so traces and receipts stay content-free.
Admin workflow catalog digest for tarot-output.ts refreshed; validate-admin-workflow-catalog passes.
untouchedSurfaces: No prompt, route, quota or app change.
No deploy: ai-tarot-reading on Singapore runs the old check until the Owner approves a redeploy.
